items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the President, Randy Wood, called me at VeeJay and wanted me to come to work for VeeJay records.

ctx.x: Wasn't there anything you could do about that?

No, there wasn't anything I could do. That's why they tell you -- independents eat you alive in the record business; if you are a small record company. That's why Motown records, you know, this is where I work now, not only an oddity but they were very fortunate because they came along at the right time. And they were in a place where they were one of a kind, you know, Motown was the only record company in Detroit. So they had that where they could make it. But for an independent record company to make it, the…
